title: BPSSC Bihar Police Havildar Instructor Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: 122 posts of Havildar Instructor (General) in Bihar Home Guard under Home Dept
ageLimit: 18 to 42 years as reported for the post (confirm in official advt)
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Further stages as per BPSSC
documentsRequired: Registration number/mobile and DOB; printed e-admit card; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in
2. Open Advt 05/2026 Havildar Instructor E-Admit Card
3. Login on apply-bpssc.com
4. Download hall ticket for 29 July 2026 exam (11 AM–1 PM)
5. Carry original ID proof
shortDescription: BPSSC Havildar Instructor (General) Advt 05/2026 Admit Card out mid-July for written exam on 29 July 2026 (122 posts).
content:
BPSSC has released the e-Admit Card for Havildar Instructor (General) under Advt. No. 05/2026.

Written exam: 29 July 2026 (11:00 AM to 1:00 PM). Admit cards available from around 13–14 July 2026. Vacancies: 122.

Download from bpssc.bihar.gov.in / apply-bpssc.com and follow instructions printed on the hall ticket.
